assumptions.progress: All players eventually complete 300 levels; no retention, revenue or solve-rate inference.
assumptions.level_workload: Actual counts in levels 1-10; repeat level 2-10 counts after 10 as workload proxy; no new layouts.
assumptions.behavior: Player-chosen equip/update strategy; real game never auto-equips. Reserve is a preference, not a budget enforced in game.
assumptions.battle: Exact grouped binomial distribution; independent PRNG samples, not production per-ship SHA identity.
assumptions.exchange: After level 4 settlement (current level 5); one strategy selects highest affordable missing rarity; alternate saves for red.
assumptions.tools: Poisson requested aid, .3 or 1.5 mean, types 40/25/35%; cap5 per attempt; assume legal use. Unfunded aid is not failed levels.
assumptions.packs: Model-only: at most one pack per ten completed levels, two or five of each. No currency prices or conversion.
assumptions.ads: Model-only: 80% completed reward assumption; caps 6 tools/1 draw/3 double per day; 90s tool cooldown; 10 completed levels/day.
assumptions.retry: Sensitivity only: 25% levels with one extra attempt, half strict deadlock, reward proxy 50%; all restarts consume daily ordinal.
assumptions.expansion: Sensitivity only: one hypothetical skin per rarity at levels101/201; no production assets added.
assumptions.chapter: Sensitivity only: 10 tickets per 10 completed levels; not a published grant.
assumptions.percentiles: Nearest lower p10/p90 and median. First-event statistics condition on reached and also report censoring fraction.
